reference.role: Species anatomy, style and costume language; a new identity, no existing portrait replacement.

prompts.neutral:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production source for a 192x192 layered dialogue portrait in the dark first-person dungeon crawler Depths.
Input reference: the existing dark elf woman portrait establishes SPECIES ANATOMY, palette, restrained pixel-art rendering and clothing language. Create a distinct new adult woman, not a copy of that regal character.
Primary request: the wounded keeper, an adult dark elf woman cut off from her people. Conventionally attractive but exhausted, proud and watchful, not apologetic. Cold muted SLATE-BLUE skin, large bold eyebrows sweeping up toward the temples, long pointed ears swept up and back with a visible inner fold, high cheekbones, straight fine nose, softly angular jaw and fuller lips. Pale silver-lilac eyes. Long straight BLACK hair, a loose side part with a few damp disordered strands; no crown, circlet, jewellery or royal ornament.
Costume: worn fluted blackened-steel gothic armour, a heavy ragged black fur shoulder mantle and a glimpse of deep faded violet cloth. One shoulder plate is damaged. One gloved hand is pressed against her lower side at the bottom of the bust, over a modest dark bloodstain in the cloth. The wound is covered; no exposed anatomy or gore. A practical guardian, not a glamorous queen or a monster.
Expression: NEUTRAL but fatigued and guarded; mouth CLOSED and both eyes OPEN. She meets the viewer's gaze with quiet resolve. Slight three-quarter turn toward image left; head upright, whole ears and hair visible.
Composition: one complete square head-and-upper-torso bust with transparent surroundings. Top of hair about8% down, eyes about36%, lips about50%, chin about62%; full chest and the supporting hand fit to the bottom edge. Symmetrical readable silhouette with shoulders clear of canvas sides. No full body, scenery or ground.
Style: restrained hand-painted pixel art with crisp native192 clusters, fine dark contours, readable facial planes and a controlled roughly48-colour palette. Match the reference's level of detail and phone-card readability. Not photorealism, anime or a glossy pin-up.
Lighting: neutral diffuse ambient illumination with local form/material shading only. No painted torch warmth, rim light, spotlight, glowing eyes or baked environmental light; lighting will be added separately at runtime.
Constraints: genuine transparent alpha outside the character. No text, watermark, frame, background, ornate headpiece, magic effects or weapons in hand. Preserve clear anatomy for fitted blink and speech drawings.
prompts.pained:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: PAINED expression for this exact wounded keeper dialogue portrait.
Edit target: supplied transparent keeper bust. Preserve her exact identity, square canvas, head position/angle, ears, hair silhouette, armour, wound, supporting hand, clothing, neutral illumination and all registration.
Change ONLY facial expression: her proud composure momentarily gives way to pain. Inner eyebrows pull up and together, the eyelids tighten into a restrained wince but both eyes remain slightly open, lips CLOSED and compressed with one corner tensed. She is exhausted and hurting, not weeping, screaming or transformed into another person. Keep the mouth, eyes, brows and nose in the same anatomical positions; modest expression movement, no head tilt.
Retain the same slate-blue complexion, pale lilac irises, restrained pixel-art shading and palette. No tears, sweat droplets, added wounds, dramatic light, face rotation, eye enlargement, new objects or text. All outside alpha stays transparent.
prompts.defiant:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: DEFIANT expression for this exact wounded keeper dialogue portrait.
Edit target: supplied transparent keeper bust. Preserve this exact woman's identity, square canvas, head position/angle, ears, hair silhouette, armour, wound, supporting hand, clothes, neutral illumination and all registration.
Change ONLY facial expression: cold proud resolve, eyes focused directly on the viewer, bold eyebrows lowered slightly and drawn in, CLOSED lips set firmly, a faint one-sided tension at the mouth. She is unapologetic and would make the same choice again. Restrained and believable, not snarling, enraged, grinning or a different character.
Keep both eyes open, exact anatomical feature positions and the same slate-blue complexion/pale lilac irises. No teeth, glowing eyes, added scars, pose change, head tilt, new objects, text or dramatic light. Preserve the same restrained pixel-art technique and transparent background.
prompts.map-reading:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve
Asset type: alternate map-reading dialogue pose of this same wounded keeper.
Edit target: supplied transparent keeper bust is the exact identity, clothing, wound and rendering reference.
Primary request: the same slate-blue adult dark elf woman looks down slightly at a small rough worn parchment route map, which she holds low in front of her with one hand. Her other gloved hand remains pressed to the covered wound at her side. Keep her long black hair, bold upswept eyebrows, swept-back ears, battered fluted black armour, fur mantle, violet cloth and weary pride. Recognisably the same woman, not a new design.
Composition: retain the square head-and-upper-torso framing, approximate character scale and shoulder footprint. Whole head/ears visible. The small folded map stays in the lower third and does not cover her face. Its paper shows only a few rough charcoal route marks, no legible writing or labels. No other people or props.
Style/lighting: same restrained hand-painted pixel art, crisp readable native192 forms, controlled desaturated palette, neutral ambient local shading. No torch glow or environmental background.
Constraints: mouth closed; attention on the map. Wound remains concealed, no gore. Genuine transparent surroundings. No camera tilt, full-body framing, added weapons, crown, symbols, text or frame. This is a distinct static pose, not a blink frame.
